description: Synthetic content exported by past Amber releases to produce the files in this directory. No real user content.
title: 合成字幕样例

sentences.speaker: lin
sentences.text: 大家好，欢迎来到今天的分享。
sentences.translation: Hello everyone, welcome to today's session.

sentences.speaker: lin
sentences.text: 我们先简单回顾一下上周的内容。
sentences.translation: Let's first briefly review last week.

sentences.speaker: lin
sentences.text: 上周我们讲了三个关键概念。
sentences.translation: Last week we covered three key concepts.

sentences.speaker: alice
sentences.text: They’re “ok” with the plan, I think.
sentences.translation: They’re “ok” with the plan, I think.

sentences.speaker: alice
sentences.text: Let me show the formula: a \ b = {x}.
sentences.translation: Let me show the formula: a \ b = {x}.

sentences.speaker: unnamed3
sentences.text: 我想补充一点：重点 & 难点要分开看。
sentences.translation: One more point: keep the key & hard parts apart.

sentences.speaker: zhangB
sentences.text: 我也同意，不过有个问题。
sentences.translation: I agree too, but I have a question.

sentences.speaker: lin
sentences.text: 这个问题我们留到最后再讨论。
sentences.translation: Let's leave that question for the end.

sentences.speaker: lin
sentences.text: 接下来我们要讨论的是一个非常长的句子，它包含了很多很多的内容，目的是让字幕在画面上放不下一行，从而触发带样式字幕的预先折行，确保每一行都不会超出画面的宽度。
sentences.translation: Next comes a very long sentence with a great deal of content, meant to be too wide for one line on screen so that styled subtitles break it in advance and no line runs past the picture.

sentences.speaker: unnamed3
sentences.translation: Thanks, everyone. See you next time.

notes: Sentences 1-3 are one turn of 林晓 and 4-5 one turn of Alice: `turn` labelling names only the first sentence of each.
Sentences 8 and 9 are two different speakers who share the name 张伟.
Speaker unnamed3 has no name and is exported as 「发言人 3」.
Sentences 6 and 10 are unassigned; sentence 10 has no translation.
Sentence 13 is wide enough for styled ASS (0.6.0+) to break it in advance with \N.
Releases before 0.6.0 had no speakers: their files were exported from the same sentences without speakers.
